title: Wall Street Week | Hubbard on Fed Cut Fallout, Open Source AI, Nuclear Bet, Department Store Revival

by Martin Coulter

Good morning Luca,



Free from the constraints of frontline politics and life as Meta’s VP of global affairs, one-time UK deputy prime minister Nick Clegg is speaking with unusual bluntness about Europe’s tech future.



When Sifted cofounder John Thornhill sat down with Mark Zuckerberg’s former right-hand man<https://email.sifted.eu/e3t/Ctc/LZ+113/d2mfCN04/VVQ_Sr4YTVlQW7X9jd17tq4r9W7MhRLh5H49PxN861KBn3qgz0W8wLKSR6lZ3n0W2vrQxF8CZpSYW5SHCLn2WC8HVW7hB2hy7rG978Vk5pdn42FTg4V2dJ868QNxn7N2DQcJlx9HT0W84r_6N5q6gD_W86-pKB8RpnldW56C8YY3ZChK8W8yFZbP51k1LBW7NSmxP4dlC1XVcYz344975KfW5B8B3F7-r1wgN1ltx8crtSGvN6GRmS2RYDM9W3Hc7B-2XWhYKW4GqWch4_sXK1W3QKYNq89mvk4W7425vm7ZSR5qW2d_YxW44PhKKN2vfgTswtQ4JW2W6_CD4czKpgW4K_QhZ3S-3VmW2qKQ2D3_qtP3VkHl7X7_1Bq5VKvc6P17f3NfW61cG-f5pfk6NW6mChtm6gwnNBf3lDdg404>, Clegg took aim at US “hypocrisy”, warned transatlantic relations may be permanently fractured — and argued Europe was actively holding itself back through “self-harming” AI regulation.



Clegg’s views carry more weight now that he’s joined Hiro Capital as a general partner, as the VC raises more than €500m to invest in European tech, with AI heavyweight Yann LeCun also on board as an advisor.



His diagnosis is familiar to founders and investors alike: Europe has world-class researchers and early-stage startups, but fails to provide the capital needed to scale.



The result? Europe nurtures generational talent but struggles to keep hold of it. “When we have good people with good ideas, we export them to the US,” he said.



Whether Clegg stands a chance at reversing the brain drain remains to be seen.
